correctness.rationale: The graph has one hub edge and n pairs of leaf edges, and all volumes use the SAME 0/1 coordinate Lebesgue measure. For each hub correlation t, the 3x3 Gram minor is a filled ellipse, and independent orthogonal residual directions give a simultaneous PSD completion of every product-fiber point. The shared symmetric hub-spin law and independent conditional leaf spins likewise complete the entire binary cut parallelogram fiber; their correlation areas are respectively pi sqrt(1-t^2) and 2(1-t^2). The coordinate Jacobian 1/4 per page produces the beta integrals, including n=1 and all n>=1. Gamma duplication and ratio expansion give sqrt(2)(pi/2)^n(1-3/(8n)+O(n^-2)); no graph-clique product law is applied across an edge. Independently integrated four n=1,2,3,7 page-fiber powers and matched the exact beta expressions to multiprecision. Finite checks corroborate only the integrals; the Gram/spin constructive fibers establish the infinite family.

value.rationale: Triangular books are the basic two-clique-sum family where sharing one edge differs from a vertex-only one-sum. Their exact PSD elliptope volume is a natural missing geometric invariant despite the known cut volume, and the provably distinct exponential ratio pi/2 versus 3 pi^2/16 for vertex gluing is a structural comparison usable in estimating semidefinite relaxation looseness.

limitations: Only edge-glued triangular books, not arbitrary chordal graphs.
